duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na

ar.text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا

en.text: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake

duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana

ar.text: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا

en.text: Our Lord, do not cause our hearts to deviate after You have guided us
